description: Make a new suite in the project: a named set of saved tests that runs as one batch. Optionally put tests in it at once. Use it to group the tests for one feature or one release check; run it with run_suite.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

tests.description: Saved test ids to put in it, as list_tests shows them.
tests.title: Tests

name: create_suite
